title: 优化文本结构，确保语法和句子结构的准确性
description:
1.这句话的语法有误，请进行修改。
The subject and verb in this sentence are not consistent.Please correct it.
2.这句话表达似乎不太合适，请重新措辞以增强清晰度。
This sentence seems inappropriate.Please rephrase it for clearer expression.
3.我在这句话中使用了被动语态，请考虑使用主动语态进行改写。
I used passive voice in this sentence.Consider changing it to active voice.
